besluite.fout: Without commas a Grade 5 reader can parse "'n bergrug skei" as its own subject and verb and stumble on the first reading.
besluite.rede: Commas set off the example so the main clause reads cleanly; meaning unchanged and the protected 'so 'n bergrug' in the next sentence is untouched.
'Reën ... loop' is natural Afrikaans, and changing only the first half breaks the parallel with 'reën aan die ander kant' in the same sentence.
